grammarFocus: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门。
title: A Better Weekend for Li Wei
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。请根据文章内容选择最佳答案。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题。
passage:
Li Wei is a 28-year-old office worker in Shanghai. He works long hours and often feels tired. Last month, he had a health check. The doctor said, "You should sleep more and exercise every day." Li Wei was worried because he often slept only five hours a night.

A. Li Wei decided to change his habits. He should go to bed before 11 p.m. because sleep is important for health. He also started walking to work. It takes 30 minutes, but he feels good. He says, "Walking is slower than the bus, but it is healthier."

B. Now Li Wei sleeps seven hours every night. He feels more energetic than before. He also eats more vegetables and less fast food. He thinks this is the best way to stay healthy. On weekends, he goes hiking with friends. Hiking is more fun than staying at home, so he never feels bored.

C. Li Wei's friend, Anna, works in the same office. She often feels stressed because she has too much work. Li Wei told her, "You should take short breaks and drink water." Anna tried this and felt better. She says, "Li Wei's advice is the most useful." Now they sometimes walk together after work. Li Wei also says, "A good weekend helps me a lot. I rest and I feel ready for Monday."

questions.prompt: Why did Li Wei go to the doctor?
questions.explanation: 文章第一段明确说“Last month, he had a health check.”，所以他是去体检。
questions.evidence: Last month, he had a health check.

questions.prompt: What did the doctor tell Li Wei to do?
options: Sleep more and exercise every day.
answers: Sleep more and exercise every day.
questions.explanation: 医生的话是“You should sleep more and exercise every day.”，选项A与原文一致。
questions.evidence: The doctor said, "You should sleep more and exercise every day."

questions.prompt: How many hours did Li Wei often sleep before?
questions.explanation: 第一段说“he often slept only five hours a night”，所以是五小时。
questions.evidence: he often slept only five hours a night

questions.prompt: Why does Li Wei go to bed before 11 p.m.?
options: Because sleep is important for health.
answers: Because sleep is important for health.
questions.explanation: 文章A段说“He should go to bed before 11 p.m. because sleep is important for health.”，原因就是睡眠对健康重要。
questions.evidence: He should go to bed before 11 p.m. because sleep is important for health.

questions.prompt: How does Li Wei go to work now?
questions.explanation: A段说“He also started walking to work.”，所以他现在步行上班。
questions.evidence: He also started walking to work.

questions.prompt: How long does it take Li Wei to walk to work?
questions.explanation: A段说“It takes 30 minutes”，所以步行需要30分钟。

questions.prompt: What does Li Wei think is the best way to stay healthy?
options: Eating more vegetables and less fast food.
answers: Eating more vegetables and less fast food.
questions.explanation: B段说“He also eats more vegetables and less fast food. He thinks this is the best way to stay healthy.”，所以他认为最好的健康方式是多吃蔬菜少吃快餐。
questions.evidence: He also eats more vegetables and less fast food. He thinks this is the best way to stay healthy.

questions.prompt: Why does Anna often feel stressed?
options: Because she has too much work.
answers: Because she has too much work.
questions.explanation: C段说“She often feels stressed because she has too much work.”，原因就是工作太多。
questions.evidence: She often feels stressed because she has too much work.

questions.prompt: What does Li Wei tell Anna to do? (Use one word from the passage: take short ______)
questions.explanation: C段中李伟说“You should take short breaks and drink water.”，所以填breaks。
questions.evidence: You should take short breaks and drink water.

questions.prompt: What does Anna say about Li Wei's advice?
questions.explanation: C段中安娜说“Li Wei's advice is the most useful.”，所以选A。
questions.evidence: Li Wei's advice is the most useful.

grammar.title: because / so; should; 比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: because 表示原因，so 表示结果。should 用来提建议，意思是“应该”。比较级用于两者比较，常加 -er 或 more；最高级用于三者及以上比较，常加 -est 或 most。
grammar.example: He should go to bed before 11 p.m. because sleep is important for health.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: I am tired, ______ I will go to bed early.
questions.explanation: 前半句是原因，后半句是结果，所以用 so。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: You ______ drink more water when it is hot.
Choose the correct form: Walking is ______ than taking the bus.
questions.explanation: 两者比较用比较级 healthier。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct form: This is the ______ way to relax.
questions.explanation: 三者及以上比较用最高级 best。
